items.mainDefect: Cross-host redirects bypass the original embed URL host validation, enabling SSRF and response-data exfiltration.

secondary.defect: Missing fetch timeouts allow a slow endpoint to tie up a job worker.

items.mainDefect: The new Disqus import path loses original thread timestamps, stamping topics at import time and scrambling chronology.

secondary.defect: Removing the category option and category forwarding causes imported Disqus topics to land uncategorized.
An unhandled synchronous fetch failure for one dead thread URL aborts the entire Disqus import run.
